reason: Eid is months away and I don't have a wedding coming up, so I can't justify $75 to $80 for a thobe when I can get an abaya for $25 online. I might save the videos and maybe stop by later, but I'm not driving up Southwest Freeway on a Sunday just to browse.
objection: $75 to $80 is a lot for something I'd wear a few times, and from a TikTok video I can't tell if the embroidery and crepe are really worth three times what I pay online.
would_change_my_mind: A Live or video showing the fabric and stitching up close next to a cheap online abaya, plus a deal on an everyday abaya and hijab together, or a family event coming up that I need an outfit for.
